issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-1d7.13 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP in note 2); filed by the sase-1d7 land agent on 2026-09-30.

task_type_fields.evidence: Reported by phase sase-1d7.13 (note 2, 2026-09-30, sase tool run check run 8ffdf8c9797c7ea3de129d6c4e598e1f): `tests/test_force_reuse_launch_seam_consume.py::test_launch_query_wipe_failure_records_and_emits` failed in the parallel just check lane and passed when rerun in isolation on the same tree. evidence.note: Proposed by sase-1dm.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 1, 'flaky launch fanout contradiction, passes in isolation'). Same cluster, so the fix should cover every launch-seam node, not just wipe_failure.

Proposed by sase-1dr.10 (note #2, sase-1dr.10--1, 2026-10-01): during the changes-feed phase's full just check, the force_reuse consume/registry fanout, wipe, and parse launch-seam nodes failed and then passed in isolation, both with and without the phase's changes (the phase touched no launch-seam code). This is the same order-dependent launch-seam cluster this bead tracks.
